entries.title: Dublin Detail & Identity Update
changes: Rebuilt College Green around Trinity College Dublin’s West Front and Front Gate.
Replaced Insomnia with Tesco on Dame Street.
Replaced Dublin Deli with Yeeros using the supplied Yeeros artwork.
Added recognisable Grafton Street storefronts including LEGO Store and Disney Store.
Upgraded shop façades, paving, railings, traffic lights, bike racks and bus-stop detail.
Added Settings and a clickable Update Log.

entries.title: Initial Live Release
changes: Launched the continuous Dame Street, College Green, Grafton Street and St Stephen’s Green route.
Added free flight, dive/grab, landing, waddling, wanted heat and Garda pursuit.
Added local progression, gull unlocks, upgrades, missions, trophies and run statistics.
Added mobile performance, pause, accessibility and persistence hardening.
